integrity: All numerical evaluations are subordinate to the exact formulas and analytical all-direction inequalities; a standalone checker and its actual output accompany the proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies to central Euclidean sections of the regular cuboctahedron only; not arbitrary affine slices, nonregular deformations, or an optimal coefficient in the global transverse inequality. Historical priority is provisional and independent validation has not been performed.
title: An oblique global minimum for central-section perimeter of the regular cuboctahedron
